disposition_reason: Nanoparticle synthesis paper; the only selenium toxicity numbers are in vitro cell-line IC50 values, not dietary exposure.

study.design: laboratory green synthesis and characterization of selenium nanoparticles; in vitro antioxidant, antimicrobial and cytotoxicity assays
study.method: UV-vis, FTIR, XRD, Raman, zeta potential, DLS, SEM-EDX, HR-TEM; MTT and live/dead assays in N2a cells

non_numeric_findings: N2a cells, MTT assay: sodium selenite IC50 14.01 and IC90 24.60 ug/mL; nanoparticle IC50 127.28 and IC90 234.41 ug/mL (Results, p. 13).
